summary: Jets, gun runs and gunships now bank into their turns, dive to aim, and climb away. They no longer slide along rails, jump in height or appear already circling.
stage: tools/showcase/support-flight.tscn --side: the Field Manual's support range (scripts/ui/support_demo.gd) over a plain floor, a camera 150 m off the run's flank panning with the aircraft
rationale: The change is motion: attitude, dive and turns. A matched side-on clip shows the gun run's dive and pull-off; a still sheet pairs one telling moment from each of the three flight profiles. The flight itself is measured by tests/aircraft_flight_test.gd.
before_ref: Clean worktree of 38b3d6b1d954178b6added13e28a5ec56cc23d7f with only tools/showcase/support-flight.gd and .tscn copied in.

capture.renderer: Godot 4.7.2 Forward+ on lavapipe (llvmpipe) under Xvfb, 1600x900, seed 7, day, no HUD
capture.comparison: Frames scaled uniformly to 800x450, before left, after right. Gun run frames 205 / 150 (each while firing), bomb run 150 / 150, gunship 0 / 90.
capture.clip: Frames 45 to 344 of the a10 takes at 30 fps, side by side 1600x450, H.264 yuv420p CRF 26, silent, faststart.

validation: node --test determinism, replay, replay-compatibility, scenarios-air-sea: pass 14, fail 0
Generated seed 3 map, every profile flown across and onto its highest ridge: no position snaps, lowest pass 12 m (gun run), bombs land along the stick
limitations: Software-rendered on a plain floor, not a battlefield. Wind, particles and the demo's own camera are not compared.
